content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I've got a [company_name] [product_name] PLC with article number [article_no], and when I upload a basic program, it works fine. However, uploading a more complex program results in this error: [article_no].L Transfer not possible, because the connected [product_name] is incompatible. Refer to the device selection dialog to check which devices are compatible for this program. [article_no].L:B005/2Input inversion not supported Download from PC to [product_name] failed. A simple test circuit uploads successfully, but expanding the circuit causes this problem. In [product_name] Comfort, the expanded circuit previews correctly using F3, so I believe the issue isn't with my circuit design. (I've also tested other circuits that worked on previous [product_name] units.) Pressing F12 shows the following compatible devices: [article_no].Standard [article_no].L [article_no].LB11 [article_no].Standard [article_no].Standard Analog [article_no].L [article_no].LB11 Other listed versions. Any help would be appreciated! Thank you.

Hello, Which instructions are you using or adding? Sometimes, especially with timers, only specific product versions support certain instructions. Can you upload an image of your logic circuit? Best regards, [user_name]
Thanks for your response. I'm using [product_name] version [version_no]. I only included two ON-delay timers. I’m not sure what information you want me to upload. Best regards, [user_name]
Have you configured your [product_name] Soft program to match the correct [product_name] version? Use CTRL+H and select [article_no].

Hello, Your [product_name] firmware doesn’t support the function indicated in the "B005..." error. You can review points 6 and 7 near the end of the errors section here: [url] Check your logic, especially comparison operations, "OR" functions, and any other used elements, and consider changing them if necessary. Best regards, I hope this helps.
Thanks for the assistance! I tried using Ctrl + H to select [article_no] standard, and it worked. Such a simple fix! Appreciate the help. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users encountered compatibility errors while uploading larger programs to a [company_name] [product_name] PLC. The main issue was using logic instructions unsupported by the hardware or firmware version. Selecting the correct device configuration in the software resolved the transfer problem. Community advice emphasized matching the software configuration to the connected [product_name] version and being mindful of firmware limitations for certain functions.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to reliably upload more complex logic circuits from their PC to the [product_name] device without running into compatibility errors. They would like the software to provide clearer guidance or to be more intuitive about compatibility constraints.
